player_prompt.intro: Wena unguMdlali {player_id}. Udlala umdlalo weMemory. Inhloso yakho ukufanisa amapheya amakhadi amaningi ebhodini, kunomphikisi wakho. Ngesikhathi sakho, khetha amakhadi amabili ozowaphendulela ngokufaka izinombolo zomugqa nekholomu yekhadi lokuqala nelesibili ngokulandelana njenge-'[0 1 1 0]', lapho ikhadi lokuqala lisemgqeni 0 nasekholomu 1, futhi ikhadi lesibili lisemgqeni 1 nasekholomu 0. Uma amakhadi amabili ehambelana, uthola iphuzu futhi amakhadi ahlala ebheke phezulu. Uma engafani, amakhadi aphindwe abuyele emuva, isibonelo '.'. Umdlalo uphela lapho wonke amapheya ehambelana.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yokunyakaza engalungile. Umdlali {player_id} akaphendulanga ngokuqondisa okuvumelekile kubakaki abakwesobunxele.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Ukudlala okungavumelekile. Umdlali {player_id} ukhethe indawo engaphandle komngcele.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Ukudlala okungavumelekile. Umdlali {player_id} ukhethe ikhadi elifanayo kabili.
invalid_move.already_matched: Ukudlala okungavumelekile. Umdlali {player_id} ukhethe ikhadi elilodwa noma womabili asevele ahlanganisiwe.

game_message.cards_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] match!
game_message.cards_no_match: The cards selected by Player {player_id} do not match. Cards at positions [{r1} {c1}] and [{r2} {c2}] are {pos1} and {pos2} respectively.

outcome.draw: Bobabili abadlali babelana ngenani elifanayo lamakhadi.
outcome.turn_limit: Umdlalo usuphelile. Umdlali 0 uthole amaphuzu {score_0}, Umdlali 1 uthole amaphuzu {score_1}.
